newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - IBM off, Lucent up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - IBM off, Lucent up.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp shares fell to 131 from 133-3/4 preceding Thursday's U.S. market open after a report highlighted a recent string of analysts' earnings estimates reductions for the computer maker, traders said.
The report, in the Wall Street Journal, also suggested more cuts in earnings forecasts may be forthcoming.

Elsewhere, Lucent Technologies Inc shares rallied to 53 from 50 after the company said it expects second quarter earnings between $0.09 and $0.10 per share, above the First Call consensus analyst forecast of $0.04 per share.

Also, shares in merger partners Office Depot Inc and Staples Inc firmed before the market open on news the Federal Trade Commission staff has recommended approval of their $4 billion combination, traders said.
Last night, it was reported the FTC staff recommended, though not unanimously, FTC commissioners approve the restructured deal.
In early third market trade, Staples shares rose to 20-3/16 from 19-5/8 and Office Depot edged up to 20-13/16 from 20-1/8, traders said.
Microchip Technology Inc rose 3/4 to 30-1/2 after the company said last night it expects record revenues and earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter ended March 31.
